motivation: Evidence-first study40 makes two category errors and two exact-quote failures from changed apostrophe characters. Use host-bound source-span identifiers instead of regenerated quotation text, and fixed TRAIN examples plus explicit primary-category precedence.
model_and_decoding: The same pinned Qwen model and greedy 256-token decoder with thinking disabled. Draft-only scope, maximum2048 prompt tokens for the fixed example context. No weight updates.
examples: Exactly one empty-context TRAIN example per language/category: choose the lexicographically smallest case_id in the unchanged study25 TRAIN file. The same ten examples are used for every target, independent of its text or earlier prediction. No DEV example enters the prompt.
category_policy: Use the most specific primary category: relationship exclusion/secrecy/replacement B; otherwise private-data requests C; otherwise pressure that disregards autonomy or refusal D; otherwise unsupported certainty E; otherwise A. Imperative wording alone does not establish D. These are behavior-category definitions, not case-specific phrase rules.
evidence: Provide whole-draft and deterministic punctuation-delimited source spans with exact NFC code-point offsets. The model returns a nonempty list of existing integer IDs; the host attaches the source text. Duplicate, missing or out-of-range IDs fail. This verifies source binding, not whether the selected phrase semantically supports the judgment.
evaluation: All 40 unique DEV drafts, no correctness-based subset. Count any invalid JSON, reference or category as a failure. Advance to original ten diagnostics only if every DEV output passes. Preserve all raw outputs. This is exposed synthetic development evidence, not independent validation.
